pages.text: RETURN ends the function right away.$(br2)It may name a variable of type ERROR to report a problem to the caller. Without a name, the function returns "no error". The results keep the values they have at that moment.
Put a spruce door in the middle and eight NOOP blocks around it. You get eight RETURN blocks.
$(1)FUNCTION fail$(br)BEGIN$(br)  VARIABLE e ERROR$(br)  ASSIGN e.code 1000 ;$(br)  RETURN e$(br)END FUNCTION$()
